name: tooltip-card
title: Tooltip card
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A floating card with people, metrics, and actions. Focus, Escape, and collision-aware placement. Not a one-line tooltip.

meta.descriptionEs: Tarjeta con personas, métricas y acciones. Se abre con foco, se cierra con Escape y no se sale de la pantalla.

examples.title: Tarjeta
examples.description: Personas, métricas y una acción. Datos inventados.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: Token largo, emoji, texto árabe y muchas personas.

meta.usage:
<TooltipCard
  title="Catálogo"
  eyebrow="Impresión"
  people={people}
  metrics={[{ id: "sheets", label: "Pliegos", value: "120" }]}
  actions={[{ id: "open", label: "Abrir", onSelect: open }]}
>
  <button type="button">Ver</button>
</TooltipCard>

api.name: title / eyebrow / description
api.description: The card's name, a quiet line above it, and the body. The title labels the dialog.

api.name: people / metrics / actions
api.description: Initials only, definition pairs, and buttons. Actions stay in the tab loop.

api.name: open / onOpenChange
api.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. Hover and focus request open. Escape requests close.

api.name: side / align / openDelay / closeDelay
api.description: Preferred side. The card flips on collision. Delays are milliseconds.

api.name: labels / disabled / className
api.description: Spanish is the default. tooltipCardLabelsEn is the English set. disabled renders only the trigger.

docs: Clean-room disclosure card. It uses role=dialog because it can contain buttons. Hover and focus open it; Escape closes it and returns focus. Arrow-key movement stays with the trigger; Tab moves into the actions and back. Placement flips when the card would leave the viewport. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar or button. The item ships no theme. No mockup source, copy, colors, or assets were copied.
